title: aster eriophorus
intro: Aster eriophorus, commonly known as the 'Hairy Flower', is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. The plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Aster eriophorus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, antipyretic, and anti-ulcerative. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
